fact: As of December 2023 the TKP social registry (11.3 million households) is linked to MoSS's Social Solidarity Pension and Social Insurance databases and to the Unified National Registry, which links 114 databases using the national ID and is used to cross-check TKP applications and to target other programmes such as food subsidies and universal health insurance.
title: Implementation Completion and Results Report: Strengthening Social Safety Net Project
